summary: The time seam: a Clock (Now, After) and a Now-only Nower, the wall-clock Real, and a hand-driven Fake whose timers fire on Advance and Set.
use_when: a test must control time instead of sleeping
code reads the current time or waits and must stay testable
a component needs a swappable time source (real in production, fake in tests)
not_for: measuring elapsed time in production: use time.Since
scheduling recurring jobs or cron: use a scheduler library, the unit only fakes Now and After
